data.name: Confounding Koan
data.description: A brazen disciple can spend 2 ki points as a standard action to confuse a target within 30 feet with a riddle or paradox. This ability functions as per confusion, except that it is language-dependent. The DC is %1, and the caster level is equal to his class level.|10+MonkLVL/2+WIS
